name: speechcare
description: SpeechCare - personal speech-language therapy assistant (Capacitor + Firebase Auth/Firestore + direct OpenRouter AI)

scripts.build:ui: tsc --noEmit && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i src/games/tailwind.css -o www/games.css --minify && esbuild src/games/main.tsx --bundle --minify --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=www/games.js && esbuild src/inventory/main.tsx --bundle --minify --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=www/inventory.js && esbuild src/native/haptics.ts --bundle --minify --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=www/haptics.js
